definitions.gloss: headwear; something worn on the head
definitions.explanation: Anything worn on the head: hats, caps, helmets, hoods, headscarves. A general word that covers what {帽子|ぼうし} does not.
A costume worn over the head, such as an animal head or a full character head at a party, festival or theme park; a common word in entertainment.

examples.japanese: {被|かぶ}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{被|かぶ}り{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: On cold days you need something on your head.

notes:
From {被|かぶ}る (to put on one's head) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing). Also written かぶり{物|もの}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {被|かぶ}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take off one's headwear
- {被|かぶ}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to wear a headpiece
- ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{被|かぶ}り{物|もの}: an animal-head costume

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧: hat, cap — a {被|かぶ}り{物|もの} of one kind
- ⟦{仮面|かめん}→仮面：11439_kamen⟧: mask — covers the face only
